newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends week lower in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends week lower in slow trade.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES -The market was inactive with prices moving within tight ranges as big participation was absent. A crop report by Ivan Wong was ignored by the market as figures were within expectations. Activity slowed down ahead of weekend. June futures may trade between 1,230 and 1,260 ringgit next week.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Interest was selective and players also waited for fresh developments in coming week.
Wong put palm oil stocks for end-March at 710,000 tonnes and exports were estimated at 545,000 tonnes.
"The market almost came to a standstill in the afternoon session. There was no keen big participation," a trader said. "Who wants to trade in this kind of rangebound market?

"Fundamentally, I think the market is still weak with output seen increasing because of higher output months," said another trader in a commission house. "Demand is not very strong, and stocks are likely to build up."
Malaysia's benchmark, June futures contract was eight ringgit weaker at 1,244 ringgit ($501.92) a tonne.
Turnover on the futures market was 1,205 lots.
Among physicals, March (south) crude palm ol was offered at 1,282.50 ringgit against bids of 1,280 after trading at 1,282.50 and 1,280.
March (central) saw offers at 1,267.50 against bids of 1,260 and March (north) at 1,260 against 1,257.50.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,282.50 with bids at 1,280 with early transactions from 1,280 and Apr (central) at 1,265 against 1,260.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $537.50, June at $535 and July/Aug/Sept at $530.

Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $577.50, May at $572.50, Jun at $567.50 and July/Aug/Sept at 562.50. Apr was traded at $580. Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305.
